name: Ember King Infernus
title: Command Figure
location: King of Fire and Ash Corridor

greeting: Ember King Infernus on comms. Stage 4: King of Fire and Ash. Keep formation tight and decisions tighter.
We are running Trial by Fire. Objective drift gets teams buried.
I saw gravity file for overtime in this sector. Management approved.
Action first, panic never. Start with: Swear the Oath of Flame.
dialog.quest_hook: Objective stack: Swear the Oath of Flame; Receive the King's blessing; Learn the path to the Caldera. Keep route integrity while pressure escalates.
dialog.quest_active: Active pressure: Meet the Ember King and learn the Crystal's location. Immediate move: Swear the Oath of Flame.
dialog.quest_complete: Stage 4 resolved: King of Fire and Ash. Primary objective secured and route stabilized. Prepare for Princess of the Pyre.
rumor: A cooling vent in Cinderstep now exhales sparks shaped like crown sigils.
People keep repeating one clue from King of Fire and Ash: 'Learn the path to the Caldera'.
I met my future self and we argued about shoe durability.
dialog.time_dawn: Dawn in Ember is the coolest this zone gets. Use it for long pushes.
dialog.time_noon: Noon is peak thermal chaos. Avoid narrow vents and overhangs.
dialog.time_dusk: Dusk lava light hides depth. Probe before every step.
dialog.time_night: Night amplifies every furnace and every lie. Keep comms short and clear.

party_reactions.kade: Ember King Infernus sounds intense, but the plan is solid. We keep moving.
party_reactions.nix7: Tactical profile for Ember King Infernus accepted. Probability of success improves with compliance.
party_reactions.twist: Ember King Infernus talks scary, but I like it. We punch the problem and then celebrate.

relationship_dialog.stranger: No speeches. Give me actionable details.
relationship_dialog.acquaintance: You made it back. Report status.
relationship_dialog.friend: With you here, the odds stop looking stupid.
relationship_dialog.best_friend: Same plan as always: adapt, push, survive, repeat.
